key_provisions_or_claims: Sets six output indicators for Member State reporting under Article 24 of the General Product Safety Regulation.
Indicators cover market surveillance resources, complaints, compliance checks, mutual assistance, corrective actions and penalties.
Member States must report in consolidated form by 22 December 2026 and annually thereafter.
Avoids duplicate reporting with ICSMS and the Safety Gate Rapid Alert System.
Commission publishes an annual public summary report.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2958 defines six output indicators Member States must use to report on market surveillance under the General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988, with consolidated annual reporting starting 22 December 2026. It has no AI or robotics content.
